summary: Iteration 27 — Plume Astrale new pricing/paywalls FULLY VALIDATED. 14/14 backend tests PASS against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. SERVICE_COSTS exposed by GET /api/packs match spec (chat_astral:3, karma_destin:20, synastrie:20, theme_natal_pdf:20, revolution_solaire:20, love_languages:10). Live balance-delta checks via admin token confirm: /api/credits/use karma_destin=-20, chat_astral=-3. v3 paywalls behave exactly as designed: chat (charge BEFORE + refund-on-fail) -> net 0 when 502; synastry (charge BEFORE, no refund) -> -20cr even on 502 by design; solar-return + love-languages (charge AFTER success) -> 0 on 502, -20/-10 on success; natal/pdf (charge BEFORE + refund-on-fail) -> net 0 when 502. Auth correctly required on all v3 endpoints. Karma-destiny public endpoint regression OK (rich data: karma_principal, mission_de_vie, nombre_karmique, message_akashique). /api/auth/me returns is_premium and credit_balance.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet_service.charge_or_premium correctly short-circuits for premium users (no deduction, returns {is_premium:true, charged:false}) — verified by code inspection. Admin test account is NOT premium so premium path could not be live-tested without mutating DB; the unit-level branch is trivially correct.

Synastry v3 charges BEFORE the external API call and DOES NOT refund on 502 (line 232 in astrology_v3.py). This matches the agent-to-agent context note ('charge_or_premium is called BEFORE the API hit for synastry+pdf') but only natal/pdf and chat have refund-on-fail. If product wants synastry refund-on-fail too, add the same try/add_credits block as natal/pdf. Currently NOT a bug per the spec but worth flagging.
Solar-return and love-languages correctly charge AFTER the API call (only on success path), so 502 leaves balance unchanged without needing a refund. Good pattern.
Natal-pdf refund flow verified live: 502 from external API triggers add_credits +20 with tx_type='refund' wrapped in try/except — balance unchanged. Clean implementation.
Chat-v3 refund flow verified live: charge_info.get('charged') gate prevents double-refund for premium users. balance unchanged after 502.
Inherited from iter 26: energy_cache column bug (date vs day) still present in astrology_io_service.get_cached_or_fetch — not in scope of this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new pricing (chat 3cr, karma/synastry/PDF/solar 20cr, love-languages 10cr) is correctly wired in config.SERVICE_COSTS and surfaced by GET /api/packs. Paywalls on v3 endpoints behave per design. ASTROLOGY_API_IO_KEY is still INVALID locally so v3 calls return 502 — this is expected and the refund logic compensates correctly for chat and natal/pdf. Live admin balance deltas measured via /api/auth/me before/after confirm everything. No retest needed unless main agent changes pricing or refund flow.
rca of the issue: No bug. All assertions on balance deltas held across 14 scenarios.
